summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.91/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.91 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 6, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 9. AAA figures put the statewide average 29¢ lower than a week ago, 10¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.16 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.68) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.25).
